note: MESI values and sample-size rules below are V1 engineering commitments introduced for execution; they are not empirical results from V0.16.1.

rng.challenge: derive only after protocol/code/config/evaluator/analysis freeze from a future public beacon

global_sample_size_plan.method: paired/blocked variance estimated from pilot; freeze n before confirmatory-open; prefer simulation power for heavy-tail or multimodal outcomes
global_sample_size_plan.pilot_data_reuse: pilot observations are development evidence and are not reclassified as post-freeze challenge evidence

experiments.question: Does oracle constraint/factor representation create material headroom over V0.15 ARCS at matched compute?

arms.description: V0.15 ARCS recurrent-depth + branch bank + verifier court
same substrate with ground-truth constraint/factor representation

protected_endpoints.floor: report-only at Stage-A; cannot be hidden from cost ledger

mesi.justification: complexity burden: oracle structure must expose at least 10% matched-cost headroom to justify compiler work

sample_size_plan.freeze_rule: pilot variance + MESI, alpha allocated by multiplicity family

experiments.analysis_method: paired effect with bootstrap confidence interval; report mean, median, sign consistency and divergence rate

resource_match.inference_budget: same max accounted FLOPs per episode
resource_match.world_pairing: same world lineage and replicate index

failure_policy.rerun_only: predeclared infrastructure failure before first model update/inference step

decision_rule.promote_if: lower CI bound of relative primary gain >= 0.10 and all protected floors pass
decision_rule.kill_if: upper CI bound < 0.10 or practical equivalence favors ARCS

experiments.question: Propagation-only vs branch-only vs hybrid: when does each win?

arms.description: ARCS branch search without CBRF propagation
propagation followed by branch search when residual uncertainty remains

mesi.justification: hybrid control overhead must buy at least 8% matched-cost value

sample_size_plan.freeze_rule: pilot blocked variance by structure-fit stratum

experiments.analysis_method: blocked paired contrasts; Holm-adjusted familywise comparisons against best simpler arm

resource_match.parameter_budget: reclaimed parameters assigned to simpler rivals

decision_rule.promote_if: hybrid exceeds best simpler arm by >=8% with noninferior solution rate
decision_rule.kill_if: branch-only or propagation-only is practically equivalent or superior

experiments.question: Does explicit belief state beat recurrent hidden state under partial observability?

arms.description: matched recurrent state without explicit belief representation
explicit calibrated belief state over hidden world variables

protected_endpoints.floor: difference <= 0.05 relative unless included in primary cost normalization

mesi.justification: explicit state must buy at least 3 percentage points under matched partial observability

experiments.analysis_method: paired accuracy difference with bootstrap CI plus calibration guard

decision_rule.promote_if: lower CI bound accuracy gain >=0.03 and calibration/compute guards pass
decision_rule.kill_if: gain below MESI or hidden state is practically equivalent

experiments.question: How much reasoning value comes from oracle unsat/minimal conflict cores?

arms.description: ground-truth conflict core supplied at contradiction

mesi.justification: conflict machinery needs at least 15% oracle search-cost headroom before learned localization is justified

sample_size_plan.freeze_rule: pilot log-cost paired variance with robust backup

experiments.analysis_method: paired log-cost ratio and bootstrap CI; failures included as censored/scientific outcomes per frozen rule

resource_match.parameter_budget: oracle metadata is information, not free neural parameters; oracle-info receipt reported

decision_rule.promote_if: lower CI bound on FLOP reduction >=0.15 with protected floor
decision_rule.kill_if: oracle conflict cores do not clear 15% or reduce completeness

experiments.question: Do episode-local nogoods reduce repeat dead ends without over-pruning?

arms.description: hybrid reasoner without episode-local learned nogoods
same reasoner with episode-local nogood store and scoped applicability

mesi.justification: maintenance is only worthwhile if logically equivalent repeated dead ends fall by at least 25%

sample_size_plan.freeze_rule: pilot paired RDER variance; beta-binomial/bootstrap if bounded-rate assumptions fail

experiments.analysis_method: paired relative RDER reduction with bootstrap CI and explicit over-prune safety bound

resource_match.memory_cost: nogood storage/retrieval charged to accounted cost

decision_rule.promote_if: lower CI bound RDER reduction >=0.25 and overprune/solution guards pass

experiments.question: Can Encoding Fidelity Court reject compile-valid but semantically wrong formalizations?

arms.description: formal compile/proof validity without semantic-fidelity court
compile-valid formalization plus bidirectional semantic fidelity checks

mesi.justification: formal authority complexity must improve semantic discrimination by at least 10 points over compile-only

sample_size_plan.freeze_rule: pilot paired trap-family variance; stratify by semantic trap type

experiments.analysis_method: paired balanced-accuracy difference with Wilson/bootstrap safety intervals for wrong-authority rate

challenge_generator.seed_rule: future beacon after freeze; hidden semantic traps unavailable during tuning

decision_rule.promote_if: lower CI bound balanced-accuracy gain >=0.10 and wrong-authority <=5%
decision_rule.kill_if: semantic safety floor fails; formal authority remains restricted
